:::{#cor-conditional-surprisal-difference}
#### Conditional surprisal as a difference

For $X$, $Y$, $x$ and $y$ as in @thm-surprisal-chain-rule,

$$\surprisalf{y \mid x} = \surprisalf{x, y} - \surprisalf{x}.$$

:::

::: {.proof}

Subtract $\surprisalf{x}$ from both sides of @thm-surprisal-chain-rule:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\surprisalf{x, y} - \surprisalf{x}
&= \surprisalf{x} + \surprisalf{y \mid x} - \surprisalf{x} \\
&= \surprisalf{y \mid x}.
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
